title: 2028年资本开支：联想CFO说还要涨，下一梯队也在抢算力？
speaker: Winston Chang

segments.en: On the server business, we can go back to that as well. Because lots of people are rethinking, and I'm not sure if it's accurate on industry braces, how much catbex is going into this.
segments.zh: 服务器业务也可以再谈。因为很多人正在重新思考，我不确定行业预期是否准确，有多少资本支出投入其中。

segments.en: What are you seeing from your perspective in terms of just the build-up going into the next couple of years?
segments.zh: 从你的角度看，未来几年的增长态势如何？

segments.en: Yeah. A lot of people are debating what will be the catbex in 2028 because the hyperscalers catbex is the debate
segments.zh: 是的。很多人在争论2028年的资本支出会怎样，因为超大规模企业的资本支出是争论焦点。

segments.en: and very clear in terms of 2027. I think there's a lot of discussions that that 2028 is still going to be an increase from 2027.
segments.zh: 2027年的情况很明确。我认为有很多讨论认为2028年仍将比2027年增长。

segments.en: Okay. Well, we're also seeing in terms of the next tier, not only the hyperscalers that you see from the US or from China.
segments.zh: 好的。我们还看到下一梯队，不仅是你看到的美国或中国的超大规模企业。

segments.en: You're also seeing kind of the next level of large, very large internet companies in the double-digit billion market cap size.
segments.zh: 你还看到下一级别的大型、超大型互联网公司，市值达数百亿美元。

segments.en: That type of companies, and maybe not the trillion-dollar ones, but a couple hundred billion.
segments.zh: 这类公司，可能不是万亿美元级别的，而是几千亿美元。

segments.en: Big enough that they are also deploying, and they're also looking for compute space and compute power.
segments.zh: 规模足够大，他们也在部署，也在寻找计算空间和计算能力。

segments.en: So I think from that perspective, you were really seeing a healthy optic.
segments.zh: 所以我认为从这个角度看，你确实看到了健康的景象。
